targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
   *
FROM predictive_new_tbl
WHERE true
-- AND "Year Lag" = '1'
   AND "Risk Factor" = '${riskFactor_filter}'
;

SELECT
   "Country",
   AVG("Diet low in whole grains_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in whole grains",
   AVG("Diet low in milk_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in milk",
   AVG("Diet high in red meat_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet high in red meat",
   AVG("Diet low in calcium_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in calcium",
   AVG("Diet low in fiber_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in fiber",
   AVG("Diet high in processed meat_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet high in processed meat"
   -- AVG("Diet low in fruits_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in fruits",
   -- AVG("Diet low in vegetables_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in vegetables",
FROM data_tbl
WHERE true
   AND "Country" IN ('Greece', 'Romania', 'Lithuania', 'Belgium', 'Italy', 'Spain')
   -- AND "Year" BETWEEN ${minyear_filter} AND ${maxyear_filter}
   AND "age" = 'Age-standardized'
GROUP BY "Country"
ORDER BY 1
;

SELECT 
   *
FROM predictive_new_tbl
WHERE true
 AND "Year Lag" = '${yearLag_filter}'
   --AND "Risk Factor" = '${riskFactor_filter}'
;

SELECT
   "Country",
   AVG("Alcohol use_${factor_filter}") AS "Alcohol Use",
   AVG("Smoking_${factor_filter}") AS "Smoking",
   AVG("Low physical activity_${factor_filter}") AS "Low Physical Activity",
   AVG("High body-mass index_${factor_filter}") AS "High Body-Mass Index"
FROM data_tbl
WHERE true
   AND "Country" IN (
   'Belgium', 'Greece', 'Italy', 'Lithuania', 'Romania', 'Spain', 
   'Andorra', 'Cyprus', 'Turkey', 'Switzerland', 'Hungary', 'Luxembourg', 
   'Sweden', 'Norway', 'Belarus', 'United Kingdom', 'Russian Federation', 
   'Netherlands', 'Montenegro', 'Austria', 'Ireland', 'Germany', 'Serbia', 
   'Portugal', 'Finland', 'Malta', 'Albania', 'Ukraine', 'Bulgaria', 
   'Croatia', 'Latvia', 'England', 'Slovenia', 'North Macedonia', 'France', 
   'Estonia', 'Slovakia', 'Monaco', 'Israel', 'Poland', 'Iceland', 
   'Republic of Moldova', 'Denmark', 'Bosnia and Herzegovina', 'Czechia')
   AND "Year" BETWEEN ${minyear_filter} AND ${maxyear_filter}
   AND "age" = 'Age-standardized'
GROUP BY "Country"
ORDER BY 1
;

SELECT
   "Year" as year_str,
   "Country" as country_str,
   AVG("Diet low in whole grains_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in whole grains",
   --AVG("Diet low in whole grains_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in whole grains",
   AVG("Diet low in milk_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in milk",
   AVG("Diet high in red meat_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet high in red meat",
   AVG("Diet low in calcium_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in calcium",
   AVG("Diet low in fiber_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in fiber",
   AVG("Diet high in processed meat_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet high in processed meat"
   -- AVG("Diet low in fruits_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in fruits",
   -- AVG("Diet low in vegetables_${factor_filter}") AS "Diet low in vegetables",
FROM data_tbl
WHERE true
   AND "Country" IN ('Belgium', 'Greece', 'Italy', 'Lithuania', 'Romania', 'Spain', 
   'Andorra', 'Cyprus', 'Turkey', 'Switzerland', 'Hungary', 'Luxembourg', 
   'Sweden', 'Norway', 'Belarus', 'United Kingdom', 'Russian Federation', 
   'Netherlands', 'Montenegro', 'Austria', 'Ireland', 'Germany', 'Serbia', 
   'Portugal', 'Finland', 'Malta', 'Albania', 'Ukraine', 'Bulgaria', 
   'Croatia', 'Latvia', 'England', 'Slovenia', 'North Macedonia', 'France', 
   'Estonia', 'Slovakia', 'Monaco', 'Israel', 'Poland', 'Iceland', 
   'Republic of Moldova', 'Denmark', 'Bosnia and Herzegovina', 'Czechia')
   AND "Year" BETWEEN ${minyear_filter} AND ${maxyear_filter}
   AND "sex" = '${sex_filter}'
   AND "age" = '${age_filter}'
  GROUP BY
      "Country",
      "Year"
ORDER BY 1,2
;

SELECT
   "Region" as region_str,
   "Value" as value_str

FROM spain_screening_risk_factors_tbl
WHERE true
   AND "Region" IN ('Andalucia', 'Aragon', 'Asturias', 'Baleares', 'Canarias', 'Cantabria', 
                  'Castilla-La Mancha', 'Castilla y Leon', 'Catalonia', 'Comunitat Valenciana', 
                  'Extremadura', 'Galicia', 'Madrid', 'Murcia', 'Navarra', 'Basque Country', 'Rioja')
   AND "Risk_Factors" = '${riskFactorRegion_filter}' 
GROUP BY "Region","Value"
ORDER BY 1
;

SELECT
   "Year" AS year_str,
   "Region" AS region_str,
   "Value" AS value_str
FROM spain_mortality_tbl
WHERE true
   AND "Region" IN ('Spain','Andalucia', 'Aragon', 'Asturias', 'Baleares', 'Canarias', 'Cantabria', 
                  'Castilla-La Mancha', 'Castilla y Leon', 'Catalonia', 'Comunitat Valenciana', 
                  'Extremadura', 'Galicia', 'Madrid', 'Murcia', 'Navarra', 'Basque Country', 'Rioja')
   AND "Year" BETWEEN ${minyear_filter} AND ${maxyear_filter}
   AND "Sex" = '${sex_filter}' 
  GROUP BY
      "Region",
      "Year",
      "Value"
ORDER BY 1,2
;

SELECT
   "Region" as region_str,
   "Value" as value_str,
   "Risk_Factors" as metric

FROM spain_screening_risk_factors_tbl
WHERE true
   AND "Region" IN ('Andalucia', 'Aragon', 'Asturias', 'Baleares', 'Canarias', 'Cantabria', 
                  'Castilla-La Mancha', 'Castilla y Leon', 'Catalonia', 'Comunitat Valenciana', 
                  'Extremadura', 'Galicia', 'Madrid', 'Murcia', 'Navarra', 'Basque Country', 'Rioja')
   AND "Risk_Factors" IN (${screening_data_metric})
GROUP BY "Region", "Value", "Risk_Factors"
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
   "Year" AS year_str,
   "Region" AS region_str,
   "Value" AS value_str
FROM spain_incidence_by_crc_tbl
WHERE "Region" IN ('Andalucia', 'Aragon', 'Asturias', 'Baleares', 'Canarias', 'Cantabria', 
                   'Castilla-La Mancha', 'Castilla y Leon', 'Catalonia', 'Comunitat Valenciana', 
                   'Extremadura', 'Galicia', 'Madrid', 'Murcia', 'Navarra', 'Basque Country', 'Rioja')
   AND "Year" BETWEEN ${minyear_filter} AND ${maxyear_filter}
   AND "Sex" = '${sex_filter}'
   AND "Age_Group" = '${Age_Group}'
ORDER BY "Year", "Region";

SELECT
   "Year" as year_str,
   "Country" as country_str,
   AVG("${crcFactor_filter}") AS values_f,
